scope.en: The resolution "Greater Than Ourselves": the benefit window (10010) and the breach window (10210).

note.zh: 10010：通过15天后发给所有成员，告知可劝失业者志愿迁居；10210：立即发给处于违规（分层经济生活水准或牲畜/奴隶/电网融合奴役）的成员国。
note.en: 10010: sent to all members 15 days after passing, announcing voluntary resettlement of the unemployed; 10210: sent at once to members in breach (Stratified Economy, or chattel / livestock / grid amalgamation slavery).

texts.zh:
随着这些权利在刚刚的[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]议案中通过，我们同时要求工人们承担更多的责任。

我们现在可以鼓励失业工人自行迁移到我们控制的其他拥有足够住房，岗位的宜居星球。
texts.en:
Alongside the rights enshrined in recent [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] resolutions, we ask additional responsibilities of our workers.

We can now encourage unemployed workers to voluntarily resettle to other worlds we control that have available housing, jobs, and are of adequate habitability.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予工作子个体更多权限的法规。

尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了转运空闲简单子个体而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。
texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their worker drones.

While this is largely meaningless to us, we can at least benefit from some of the infrastructure they have created in order to resettle inactive simple drones.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予劳工更多权益的法规。

尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了安置空闲子个体和劳工们而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。
texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their workers.

While this ruling is largely meaningless to us, we can derive some token benefit from the infrastructure they created for resettling their own inactive drones and laborers.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了自我升华议案，禁止阶层经济生活标准，同时禁用奴隶劳工，牲口及并入电网奴隶类型。

我国目前与该议案内容相违背，是否要修改对应政策以遵守该议案？
texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Greater Than Ourselves resolution, which bans Stratified Economy living standards, as well as Chattel Slavery, Livestock, and Grid Amalgamation slavery types.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

summary.text:
# 自我升华 / Greater Than Ourselves

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 决议“超越自我”（resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves）通过：effect 立即向违规者发出 10210，并在15天后向所有成员发出 10010。
  When the resolution "Greater Than Ourselves" passes its effect fires 10210 at once at members in breach and 10010 at all members 15 days later.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 10010：告知现在可鼓励失业工人自愿迁居其他宜居世界；选项仅确认。
  10010: announces that the unemployed can now be encouraged to resettle voluntarily; the option only acknowledges.
- 10210：禁止分层经济生活水准与牲畜/奴隶/电网融合奴役；选项：令奴隶充军 / 为仆役 / 遵守 / 保留 / 拒不服从（排外威权者的版本带团结奖励）。
  10210: bans Stratified Economy and chattel / livestock / grid-amalgamation slavery; options: make the slaves fight / serve, comply, retain, refuse (xenophobic authoritarian variants add unity rewards).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 两个窗口面向不同对象，并行。
  The two windows address different empires and are parallel.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项取决于是否军国主义、奴役类型与生活水准。
  Options depend on militarism, slavery type and living standard.

  Checked: the resolution effect triggers and delay, the conditions of both windows.
